To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed an efficient method to rapidly analyze gene expression in brain microvascular endothelium, which is a key cell type in the blood-brain barrier.
immuno-laser-capture microdissection (LCM) coupled to a TaqMan Low Density Array is a highly sensitive and rapid method for profiling gene expression in the central nervous system.

immuno-LCM coupled to TLDA allows for rapid, reproducible, and sensitive global expression profiling of small amounts of brain tissue, and is therefore an excellent method for studying the nervous system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new therapeutic strategies for the treatment of brain disorders
the molecular regulation of the blood-brain barrier (BBB).
the molecular mechanisms that regulate brain endothelial cell (BEC) function in health and disease
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
immuno-LCM combined with TLDA is an effective, rapid and highly reproducible method for gene profiling in the brain.
this is a very effective tool that is both time efficient and cost effective for screening and validating gene expression in the nervous system and in other tissues.
this is the first time that a TLDA has been applied for the analysis of LCM material.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the combination of immuno-LCM with TLDA is an efficient, sensitive, rapid, and inexpensive alternative to traditional RNA purification and labeling protocols when profiling small samples of tissue for gene expression.
the combination of immuno-LCM and TLDA provides a very effective and rapid means to profile the expression of a large number of genes of interest in a specific cell population of interest.
this method can be used to rapidly screen and validate gene regulation in health, and in disease of the nervous and other tissues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TLDA platform is an ideal tool for rapid expression profiling of limited samples of LCM-retrieved tissue.
TLDA can be used to rapidly and reliably profile gene expression in small amounts of tissue acquired by LCM.

immuno-LCM coupled to Taqman Low Density Arrays can provide a rapid and sensitive method for global gene expression profiling of a specific cell population within complex tissues, including the brain.
